notes: Excellent work. All 9 tests pass. Implementation perfectly matches spec requirements for reader.py: loads .note files via supernotelib, extracts modified pages as PNG, transcribes via Claude Sonnet 4-6 vision API, diffs checkbox state with JSON snapshot persistence, detects focus/orbit tags, and classifies content (task/snippet/general). ReadResult dataclass correctly structures all outputs. The low FLIP score (0.49) was a false alarm—verification caught spec gaps (ReadResult, snapshot persistence, checkbox tags, page_num, model version, LLM snippet classification) and the agent fixed all 6 issues directly, then expanded tests from 5 to 9, all passing. Code is clean, well-structured, and ready for downstream integration. Minor efficiency note: async vision API calls could theoretically be batched for multiple pages, but current approach is justified and maintainable.
